name: pnp-list-formatting-key-dates-timeline-checklist
title: Key Dates Timeline Checklist
shortDescription: A modern horizontal timeline view that displays key dates or milestones as monthly columns.
longDescription: A modern horizontal timeline view that displays key dates or milestones as monthly columns. Each month shows a progress bar and up to 5 checklist items that users can mark as completed directly in the view.

references.name: Use view formatting to customize SharePoint
references.description: You can use view formatting to customize how items in SharePoint lists and libraries are displayed. To do this, you construct a JSON object that describes the elements that are displayed when an item is loaded in a view and any styles to be applied to those elements.
